_note: secretary tier (K) — `claude --mcp-config` shape. The K-owned kstore working store (work-items, lessons) is mounted so K can track tickets/memory; status-write self-gates to workflow runs. The logistics-mcp (calendar/notes/scheduling) is mounted so K can keep run-scoped notes, calendar events, and reminders (STORAGE, not execution — it does not act on any real calendar). The same portable gitnexus stdio server the chief mounts gives K code intelligence, used READ-ONLY — enforced at the GRANT layer (SEAMS#2 f): the allowlist grants gitnexus PER-TOOL and excludes the write-capable rename/group_sync and graph-write-capable cypher, so the charter's read-only rule is backed by the allowlist, not prose alone. The synthesizer rewrites `__KSTORE__` / `__LOGISTICS__` + the env placeholders at run time. The reused Google Calendar/Gmail/Drive connectors remain deferred. allowDiscoveredServers=false (D-070): the secretary tier never admits host-discovered MCP servers.
